name: Test Biped, Collision Above Its Feet
_note: Valid content that makes a broken creature, which is why it is a fixture rather than a bug. Its one collision box spans 1.0 m to 1.8 m — nothing at all below the hip — and every part of that is legal: FORMAT-SPEC says a collider is one to four hand-fitted boxes and says nothing about where they have to reach.
_why_it_breaks: A `Walker`'s body origin is what its feet are measured from: `Locomotion.step` plants against the transform it is handed, which is the body's own. So a creature whose lowest box stops a metre above its soles settles a metre into the ground, and then every foot is asked to reach *upward* for a surface above its own ideal position and cannot. The symptom is a creature buried to the hip with all its feet reported unplanted, and nothing about it points at the collider — which is why `Walker._check_stance` says so in words at build time. `testpack:horse` shipped with a milder version of exactly this (its collision stopped at the barrel, where a horse's body is) and it took longer to find than it should have. This fixture exists so that guard has something that trips it: a check nobody has ever seen fire is a check nobody knows still works.
